Intel: Java package declaration emitted as Module so callers can build FQNs (#112)

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"package com.example.widget;

public class Widget {
    public String name() { return "w"; }
}
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"java"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure[0].kind);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
}
```
